purpose: Obtain safe validation diagnostics for the rejected customer creation without changing its payload.
preconditions: Read-only reconciliation found no matching customer by both document formats or stable code in A/B/I/E.
Original batch and customer reservations remain immutable.
Rebuild payload from the same private approved company data and existing Cliente type ID; require its hash to equal the original reserved customer payload hash.
Recheck account and absence within the original remaining GET budget.

proposedAdditionalPost.payload: Exactly the original reserved customer payload; no normalization, correction, replacement buyer or extra fields.

effects: The additional POST can create one real customer with the same approved fiscal data and situation B. It does not itself create product, variation or order.
onSuccess: Persist confirmed customer ID, reconcile exact fiscal fields, type, situation and code. Only then resume the five still-unexecuted dependent POSTs already approved, preserving their exact payloads and original safeguards.
onRejectionOrUncertainty: Capture only allowlisted validation field names and coarse categories; preserve the new reservation; no further retry, correction or dependent POST.
